Fixed public web search rejecting valid DuckDuckGo results. The reader now accepts either HTML attribute order and additional CSS classes. Conversational “So” is removed from the search subject, preventing dictionary results from dominating the Bing fallback.

The reported iPhone query previously failed before reaching the model. After the fix, the same live query retrieved results and read four destination pages in 2.07 seconds on the tested connection. Public providers can still block requests or return poor results; no search-availability guarantee is implied. Denial pages and unrelated results remain rejected, and existing deadlines and cancellation remain intact.

Includes the lean direct-chat, model-specific defaults and context-budget fixes from v0.4.30. Native model reasoning limitations and unmeasured Windows GPU performance remain as documented in [the direct Chat audit](https://github.com/UnnamedCoder-568/Uncloud/blob/main/qa/direct-chat-audit-2026-10-12.md). This patch adds no model instructions or inference pass.

Validation: both regressions reproduced before the fix; all 14 search tests, 1,096 local backend tests (one skipped), 148 frontend tests, backend lint and release-resource checks passed. Backend tests used temporary settings and home paths. Live search/page-reading evidence is in [the search report](https://github.com/UnnamedCoder-568/Uncloud/blob/main/qa/public-search-2026-10-12.json). No model weights were loaded and Chrome was not operated during this patch verification.
